requirement.clarified: Persist meal-slot un-gating (skipped:false, skipped_reason:null) across page reload by emitting the existing 'skip' mutation through the existing autosave pipeline at the three un-gating/selection sites. Restrict skip emits to the 3 real persisted meal slots (breakfast/lunch/dinner) via a NEW SKIPPABLE_MEAL_SLOTS set so the non-schema 'meals-any' pseudo-slot never reaches disk; cover BOTH source and target meal slots of any move (de-duplicated) so neither re-gates. Use existing standard schema only; no new field/mutation types.
requirement.what: Wire the existing-but-unused 'skip' mutation into the front-end un-gating/selection sites so skipped:false persists to day-NN.json on reload, gated by a NEW SKIPPABLE_MEAL_SLOTS=Set(breakfast,lunch,dinner) (NOT MEAL_SLOTS, which includes the non-schema meals-any), with symmetric source+target coverage at all 3 sites.
requirement.why: Prior cycle fixed un-gating in React state only; on reload the slot re-gates and selection can be lost, violating the ultimate-UX requirement. QA round 1 rejected v1 for (1) gating on MEAL_SLOTS which admits meals-any -> schema-invalid disk write, and (2) not un-gating the SOURCE slot of a move (Site C board branch) -> source re-gates on reload.

out_of_scope_observations.observation: _get_or_create_slot calls day['slots'].setdefault(slot_id, ...) with NO validation against day.schema.json's slot allow-list, so any client-supplied slot (e.g. meals-any, typos) silently writes a schema-forbidden key. This cycle guards client-side via SKIPPABLE_MEAL_SLOTS; a defense-in-depth server-side slot-key allow-list check would be more robust but is path-external to the user-stated un-gating need. Recorded for visibility; not fixed this cycle.

root_cause_analysis.symptom: User un-gates a meal slot in-session (drag away default + place new restaurant); on reload the slot re-gates and the new selection can be lost.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: The two React-state writes that clear slots[X].skipped=false (react_template.tpl:2366, 2963) never emit a 'skip' mutation, so day-NN.json retains skipped:true, skipped_reason:'pre-arrival'. The front-end has zero 'skip' mutation emit sites despite the server handler and schema fully supporting it. Two correctness sub-causes surfaced by QA round 1: (a) MEAL_SLOTS (the candidate guard) includes the non-schema 'meals-any' pseudo-slot, so gating skip emits on it would write a forbidden slots['meals-any'] key to disk; (b) move handlers (Site C board branch, Site B origin) empty a SOURCE meal slot but only the TARGET was un-gated, leaving the source skipped:true on disk -> re-gates on reload.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A - persistence was explicitly out-of-scope in prior cycle 20260527-062755
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Prior cycle scoped the fix to in-session React state only; persistence deferred.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Disk state diverges from in-session state; reload reverts the un-gate, breaking ultimate-UX expectation.
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Gap present since prior cycle 20260527-062755 added the React-state un-gate writes.

development_approach.strategy: At each meal-slot un-gate/selection site, add a 'skip' mutation (skipped:false, skipped_reason:null) to the saveMutations call alongside the existing select emission. Site A (handleSidebarDrop, emit inside MEAL_SLOTS guard not at the shared 2406 line), Site B (applyBridge, inside MEAL_SLOTS guard), Site C (Timeline drop line 1915 — board + setEditorSelection-fallback branches, guarded by meal-slot check on toSlotId; candidates branch already covered via applyBridge=Site B). Batch skip+select into one saveMutations array per site. No server/schema changes; no new gating logic for the codex-F2 stage-gate edge (documented as validation-time observation, out of scope).

codex_consult.feedback_summary: Codex (gpt-5.5 xhigh) read all three files and ran the server handler to verify. Confirmed the skip payload shape is exactly correct (F1) and ordering is irrelevant (F6). Flagged: F3 (skip emit must stay inside the meal-only guard, not at the shared unconditional select line) and F4 (a THIRD selection path — Timeline drop at line 1915 — can select onto a still-skipped meal slot, defeating reload-survival). F2 (stage-gate validation interaction on already-approved days) and F5 (React-only options[] synthesis not persisted) noted as observations.

findings.issue: F1: skip payload shape {type:'skip', slot, extra:{skipped,skipped_reason}} is exactly what _apply_skip_mutation consumes; use 'slot' not 'slot_id'
findings.rationale: Confirms spec AC4/Contract C; no change needed.

findings.issue: F2: emitting skip(false)+select(null) on a day already at stage>=user-selected leaves a required meal slot skipped:false + selected_option_id:null, which _check_stage_gate (validators.py:368) would flag at validation time
findings.proposed_fix: Only emit Site A skip(false) on editable pre-approval stages, or require explicit re-edit flow on approved days
findings.rationale: Validation-time only (save.py does not run the stage gate); does not block AC3 persistence. Adding new stage-conditional gating is new logic = out of scope for this 'no new logic' cycle. Documented as edge case; if user later reports a validation failure post-deselect on approved days, separate cycle.

findings.issue: F3: skip emit must not be appended to the unconditional select(null) at line 2406 which also fires for non-meal slots; the local skipped clear at 2366 is meal-only
findings.proposed_fix: Add skip mutation only inside the breakfast/lunch/dinner meal-only condition, not accommodation/activity/meals-any
findings.rationale: Incorporated into Must-Have + Edge Cases: skip emit placed inside MEAL_SLOTS guard (2355/2957) at Sites A/B; meal-slot predicate on toSlotId at Site C.

findings.issue: F4: Timeline drop handler (line 1915) is a third path that can select onto a meal slot while skipped:true remains on disk (board branch + setEditorSelection fallback bypass applyBridge); reload re-gates
findings.proposed_fix: For any direct select path targeting breakfast/lunch/dinner, include the same skip(false) mutation for the target slot
findings.rationale: Verified at react_template.tpl:1915 — candidates branch delegates to applyBridge (Site B, covered); board + setEditorSelection-fallback branches need own skip emit. Added as Site C + AC2b.

findings.issue: F5: React-only options[] synthesis (Site A 2352-2401) is not persisted by skip; a synthesized option absent from disk options[] won't reappear after reload
findings.proposed_fix: Ensure the option exists in disk options[] before selection; otherwise out of scope for skip-only fix
findings.rationale: Does not block skipped:false survival. Site B placement uses real disk options (sidebar candidates sourced from options[]), so AC3 selected_option_id resolves. Documented as edge case.

findings.issue: F6: skip/select ordering in the mutations array does not matter (independent fields, sequential apply)
findings.rationale: Confirms batching is safe in either order.
